name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO said on 18 Nov the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic remains a PHEIC; no new emergency declared in 30 days
state: WHO said on 18 Nov, after its Emergency Committee met on 17 Nov, that the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in DR Congo remains a public health emergency of international concern, first declared on 17 May (WHO). Kenya and Nigeria have begun 42-day countdowns after imported cases (WHO, 20 Nov). No new PHEIC or pandemic emergency was declared in the past 30 days, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Follow WHO and UKHSA guidance and FCDO travel advice for DR Congo and neighbouring countries.
rubric_hit: PHEIC in effect (Ebola, since 17 May) = Watch; none new in 30 days

rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
